title: What happened to it: a first look at bǎ sentences
summary: Slide the object before the verb with 把 bǎ to report what was done to a known thing.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Ordinary word order is verb then object: 我关了窗户 wǒ guān le chuānghu. The 把 bǎ pattern moves the object in front of the verb so the sentence is about what happened to it: 我把窗户关了 wǒ bǎ chuānghu guān le. Think of 把 bǎ as the older verb meaning to hold, which now works as a marker, and the whole sentence answers what was done to the thing in hand. Two rules bite at first. The object must be something the listener can identify, so 我把一个窗户关了 wǒ bǎ yí ge chuānghu guān le is odd. And the verb must carry an outcome: 了 le, a result, a direction, or repetition. A bare verb is left hanging.

That is why 请 qǐng (please) shows up so often with 把 bǎ, and why requests sound neat: 请把门关上 qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng, 请把这张表填好 qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng biǎo tián hǎo, 请把水递给我 qǐng bǎ shuǐ dì gěi wǒ. The object is understood as yours or ours, and the complement closes the deal. Notice how the earlier lessons meet here: a result complement about outcomes, a time word about order. When a sentence is only about the action, keep the plain order: 我看书 wǒ kàn shū, not 我把书看 wǒ bǎ shū kàn. For verbs of naming, thinking, or having, 把 bǎ is simply wrong: 我把书有 wǒ bǎ shū yǒu is not a sentence at all.

body.speaker: A
body.zh: 请把那个箱子放到桌子上。
body.py: qǐng bǎ nàgè xiāngzi fàng dào zhuōzi shàng.
body.en: Please put that box on the table.

body.speaker: B
body.py: fàng hǎo le. zhèxiē shū zěnme bàn?
body.en: Done. What should I do with these books?

body.speaker: A
body.py: bǎ tāmen zhuāng jìn dàizi ba.

body.speaker: B
body.py: yàoshi wǒ ná dào le, bié dānxīn.
body.en: I got the keys, do not worry.

blocks.title: Practise these
body: 请把这段话翻译一下。 qǐng bǎ zhè duàn huà fānyì yíxià. — Please translate this passage.
他把杯子打破了。 tā bǎ bēizi dǎ pò le. — He broke the cup.
你先把这个句子读一遍。 nǐ xiān bǎ zhège jùzi dú yí biàn. — Read this sentence through first.
我们八点以前把作业交给老师。 wǒmen bā diǎn yǐqián bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī. — We hand the homework to the teacher before eight.
请把伞留在这里吧。 qǐng bǎ sǎn liú zài zhèlǐ ba. — Please leave the umbrella here.
她把名字写在第一行。 tā bǎ míngzi xiě zài dì yī háng. — She wrote her name on the first line.

blocks.body: Independent, unofficial practice material written from scratch for general learners of Mandarin. It teaches the bǎ construction, and nothing in it is taken from, copied from, or aligned to any commercial course, textbook brand, app, or official exam. It is not an answer key for any test.
